aliases: Vermillion Rise crypto mining and data center facility
status_detail: Terra Hosting announced it had expanded to Indiana by repurposing a former U.S. military base at/near Vermillion Rise for crypto mining and data center operations; local business reporting says operations had begun and investment was expected to surpass $20M.
notes: Included as a crypto mining / colocation / data center compute facility; public capacity in MW not found during county pass.

project_name: Potential Vermillion Rise hyperscale data center
aliases: Vermillion Rise Mega Park data center
status_detail: County materials and local reporting/social posts show public discussion, resident opposition, and county ordinance activity around potential data center development at Vermillion Rise Mega Park; official commissioner material identifies Vermillion Rise Mega Park as the primary/preferred location for data centers/digital infrastructure in the county.
notes: Potential project only; developer, application status, and capacity not confirmed. Kept separate from Terra Hosting because public references describe a hyperscale AI/data-center prospect at Vermillion Rise.

status_detail: No project found in quick county/EDA/news search. Search results surfaced a Tribune-Star/Facebook item saying Vigo County commissioners had not been contacted about a data-center location in the county, plus unrelated county IT 'Data Center' references for government web operations.
notes: No commercial/hyperscale/colocation project identified; county 'Data Center' PDF is an internal Vigo County IT/web-posting policy and not a development project.

status_detail: No specific project found. County plan documents show a proposed temporary moratorium on data-center applications/permits and Grow Wabash County has a 'Data Center' economic-development navigation/category page, but neither identified a named project or applicant.
notes: Moratorium language is relevant evidence of county-level review but not evidence of a filed data center project.

status_detail: No reliable Warren County, Indiana data-center project found in county/news/EDA search. Search results were dominated by other Warren Counties, generic data-center consultants, social posts, and utility commentary about rural data-center demand.
notes: Do not confuse with Warren County, Mississippi/Amazon or Warren County, Missouri items surfaced by broad search.

developer: Project Zora development team / Sourecolo reference in early reporting
status_detail: Warrick County officials and Economic Development representatives met with the Project Zora development team on July 30, 2026; county/news reporting says the developer controls about 1,200 acres of reclaimed mine land in northern Warrick County, with a preliminary concept to develop about 300 acres. No formal application/site review had been submitted as of Aug. 10, 2026; no county approvals or NDA; no permit applications expected before Jan. 2027.
notes: County page links an official 'Update on Preliminary Data Center Inquiry' PDF, but the CDN PDF returned 403 in browser fetch; WFIE quotes the official release details.

status_detail: No named project found for Washington County, Indiana. Search found local discussion and a reported/citizen-transcript one-year moratorium on commercial/large-scale data centers, but no applicant, site, developer, or formal project. Separate 'Washington, Ind.' project is in Daviess County and excluded.
notes: County seat Salem; avoid conflating with Outrigger Industrial proposal near Washington city in Daviess County.

status_detail: No Wayne County, Indiana data-center project found in county/EDA/news search. Broad search results primarily returned Wayne County, Michigan/Van Buren Township, Wayne County, Pennsylvania, generic consultant pages, and unrelated county IT/security documents.
notes: Do not confuse with Wayne County, Michigan data-center proposals.

status_detail: No specific project found. Wells County Council minutes from Apr. 7, 2026 say the economic-development lead confirmed data-center inquiries but nothing requiring further conversation; EDC pages use 'Data Center' as a site navigation/category for community data, not a project listing.
notes: Inquiries only; no named applicant/site/capacity found.

status_detail: A 322-acre data-center campus proposed south of US Highway 24 and next to N 1100 W near Wolcott; reported concept includes four 327,612 sq ft data-center buildings, two substations, warehouse, and office building. Developer reportedly had not yet acquired the land parcel or secured an end user as of early July 2026.
notes: White County also had reported moratorium activity after public opposition/rezoning uncertainty; capacity not found.

status_detail: No formal project found. Local reporting says Whitley County planners had received inquiries about possible data-center sites but no formal development applications; a June 24, 2026 listening session addressed possible zoning standards and resident concerns.
notes: Recorded as no project because reporting explicitly states no formal applications and no one 'knocking on our door' to put a data center in.
